acceptanceCriteria: `corvint impact` on a change to a bootstrap script or env file lists the tests whose env contract it alters, citing the source.
Non-default profiles are supported or refused with a named code.
Use-case receipts are re-frozen and the impact spec gains numbered requirements.
body: V1-1947 criterion (c) second half, NOT_PRODUCED by PR #1211 (TSA-V0-350..363): `corvint impact` is a core indexed command that refuses .sh paths, has frozen receipts, and its providers serve only the default profile, so a bootstrap offset change does not list affected tests there. Existing equivalent: `corvint tests env --base` (TSA-V0-215). Needs an impact-spec requirement, profile-aware providers, and a receipt re-freeze.
title: corvint impact: list tests affected by a test-bootstrap change (profile-aware providers)
